rates.descriptionEn: Supervised play area inside the restaurant for ages 0–13. Children under 3 must be accompanied. A parent or authorised adult must handle drop-off and pick-up; bring clean socks or slippers. Children with symptoms cannot enter. Call to confirm the time and any table requirement. The price includes VAT.

businesses.tariffScope: Literal public VAT-inclusive EUR amount for a one-hour visit. One hour is the quoted service unit, not an inferred minimum for all visits. No meal or table purchase is stated on the child-centre page; do not promise that none is required. No birthdays, restaurant menus, full day rates, prices converted from BGN, unverified sports activities, opening hours or availability are imported.
